feed.title: The Marram Coast Record
feed.subtitle: Coastal news for the Marram estuary

entry.title: Harbour dredging pushed back to autumn after survey finds silt has shifted
entry.summary: The dredger booked for June has been released to another port after a bathymetric survey found the silt bank has migrated 40 metres east.

entry.title: Ferry operator opens consultation on a reduced winter timetable
entry.summary: Four sailings a day from November to March, down from seven, with the 07:10 retained. The consultation runs for six weeks.

entry.title: Tidal Reach at the Harbour Lights, reviewed
entry.summary: A play about a tidal barrage should not be this funny, and the second act should not be this long.
